items.title: Labcorp (LH) Stock Fair Value Edges Higher After Q3 Analyst Revisions
items.summary: The fair value estimate for Labcorp Holdings has been adjusted from US$344.25 to US$354.50, a move of about US$10.25 that reflects updated analyst work after the latest Q3 review. items.title: Labcorp Holdings (LH) Expands HPV Testing While Teaming With Regulators On Drug Safety
items.summary: Labcorp Holdings (NYSE: LH) partnered with Waters Corporation to deploy the BD Onclarity HPV Assay across its national laboratory network. The BD Onclarity HPV Assay rollout is designed to broaden access to advanced cervical cancer screening for patients across the United States. Labcorp announced a collaboration with the FDA and Charles River Laboratories to refine methods used to evaluate drug abuse potential. items.title: Labcorp (LH) Stock Shrugs Off Q3 Earnings As PAMA Risk Looms
items.summary: Labcorp stock barely flinched after its Q3 2026 release, ticking around 0.6% higher near US$362 even as the company posted a muscular quarter. Revenue reached about US$3.8b and adjusted earnings per share jumped to US$4.78, with free cash flow of US$412m giving the testing giant more financial firepower.
